item.title: PMS 2.0 1644 - MNF Recap, Pat Freiermuth, Rece Davis, PK Subban, Ian Rapoport, Dana White, Darius Butler, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, DBut, AJ Hawk, and the boys recap last night’s overtime thriller between the Bills and Rams, preview tonight’s Frozen Frenzy in the NHL, discuss massive upcoming fights in the UFC and boxing world, and much more!  Joining the progrum is Steelers Tight End Pat Freiermuth to discuss his role in the Steelers offense, Coach Mike McCarthy’s coaching style, taking snaps under center, Aaron Rodgers being locked in and focused on winning a Super Bowl in what could be his final season, and the expectations Rodgers has for his teammates.  Next, College GameDay host Rece Davis joins the show to reveal his personal Top 25 teams in college football and preview College GameDay heading to Provo, Utah. He also breaks down his Rece’s Pieces from the weekend, including Georgia’s offensive line, Will Stein’s impact at Kentucky, and Ty Dieffenboch stepping in for an injured Nico Iamaleava at UCLA. Rece also reacts to who sits atop Tone’s Above Average Poll.  Later, 13-year NHL veteran, 3x All-Star and ESPN Hockey Analyst, P.K. Subban joins the show to break down everything happening around the league ahead of tonight’s Frozen Frenzy, featuring all 32 NHL teams in action. Then, Junior NFL Insider for ESPN Ian Rapoport stops by to discuss the Rams signing kicker Blake Grupe, Marvin Harrison Jr. being traded to the Texans, trade discussions surrounding Jauan Jennings, an update on Caleb Williams following his hamstring injury, the latest on Myles Garrett’s timetable, and more news from around the NFL.  Lastly, UFC President and CEO Dana White joins the boys to discuss the upcoming Anthony Joshua vs. Tyson Fury fight on Friday, December 11th, his experience entering the boxing world as a co-founder of Zuffa Boxing, and the finale of his Contender Series on Paramount+.  Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or watch on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+.  We appreciate the hell out of all of you! We’ll see you tomorrow. Cheers. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: PMS 2.0 1643 - OVERREACTION MONDAY, NFL Week 5 Recap, MNF Preview/Picks, Adam Schefter, Dan Orlovsky, Darius Butler, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, DBut, AJ Hawk, and the boys overreact to everything from the weekend as the NFL continues to be as unpredictable as ever, while college football keeps delivering chaos of its own. Joining the progrum is Senior NFL Insider for ESPN Adam Schefter to provide updates on Will Shipley and the Eagles’ banged-up backfield, the Commanders’ late-game blunder against the Giants that resulted in a tie, Michael Penix Jr.’s rib injury against the Ravens, Tyler Huntley stepping in for an injured Lamar Jackson, the blockbuster trade sending Marvin Harrison Jr. to the Houston Texans and the reporting process behind it, plus injury updates ahead of tonight’s Monday Night Football matchup between the Bills and Rams in Los Angeles. Later, 12 year NFL veteran at QB and ESPN NFL Analyst, Dan Orlovsky joins the show to break down the Commanders’ lack of awareness and communication at the end of their game in New York, Drake Maye and the Patriots’ offensive performance, Sean Payton taking over play-calling duties for the Broncos, Brock Purdy, and more from around the league.  Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or watch on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+. We appreciate the hell out of all of you! We’ll see you tomorrow. Cheers. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: PMS 2.0 1642 - TNF Recap, NFL Week 5 Preview/Picks, Ian Rapoport, Nick Saban, Stanford Steve, Mike Greenberg, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, AJ Hawk, and the boys chat about Tampa Bay’s surprise win last night in Dallas, this weekend’s college football slate—including College GameDay being in Tuscaloosa for Georgia-Alabama—and make their picks for Week 5 of the NFL.  Joining the progrum is Junior NFL Insider for ESPN, Ian Rapoport as he reflects on the career and life of Mike Ditka, who passed away this morning. He also provides an injury update on CeeDee Lamb, who seemingly got banged up in last night’s loss to the Buccaneers, discusses the statuses of Tee Higgins and Ja’Marr Chase, trade talk surrounding Marvin Harrison Jr., and more news from around the league heading into Week 4.  Next, 7x National Champion and the greatest football coach of all time, Nick Saban, stops by to talk about Sean Payton taking back play-calling duties for the Broncos, the premiere of his six-part self-titled documentary, Saban, this Alabama team with Keelon Russell at quarterback, and tells more stories from his days as a coach.  Then, The Udder Guy, Stanford Steve, joins the boys to pick the entire NFL slate for Week 4.  Lastly, ESPN legend and host of Get Up, Mike Greenberg, comes on the show to share some words and memories of Mike Ditka, who he says was “larger than life” and “the biggest star in Chicago sports.”  Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or catch the show on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+.  We appreciate the hell out of all of you. We’ll see you tomorrow. Cheers. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: PMS 2.0 1641 - TNF Preview/Picks, Bryce Young, Kirk Herbstreit, Georgia Head Coach Kirby Smart, Tyrese Haliburton, Coach Chuck Pagano, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, AJ Hawk, Coach Chuck Pagano, and the boys break down everything happening around the football world, including another edition of “What The Chuck?”, Last Week’s Shite Division and tonight’s Thursday Night Football preview between the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Dallas Cowboys.  Joining the progrum, Carolina Panthers Quarterback and former Heisman Trophy winner Bryce Young returns for the second time this week with a major announcement: he’ll be the Celebrity Guest Picker on College GameDay this Saturday in Tuscaloosa.  Next, Thursday Night Football color commentator and the voice of college football, Kirk Herbstreit joins the show to preview a massive weekend of college football, including Georgia vs. Alabama, and shares his expectations for tonight’s Bucs-Cowboys matchup. Kirk also reflects on Lane Johnson’s incredible career and discusses how the Philadelphia Eagles move forward. Later, 2x National Champion and Georgia Head Coach Kirby Smart stops by to discuss his relationship with Nick Saban, the impact Saban has had on his coaching career, and his mindset heading into a massive showdown with the Crimson Tide.  Plus, Indiana Pacers superstar Tyrese Haliburton joins the progrum to talk about making his preseason return after 472 days away with an Achilles injury, what it meant to get back on the court at Iowa State, and his expectations for the upcoming Pacers season, streaming exclusively on DAZN.  Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or catch the show on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+.  We appreciate the hell out of all of you. item.title: PMS 2.0 1640 - Watt Wednesday with JJ Watt, Jason Kelce, Canelo Álvarez, In the Trenches with AQ Shipley, Everything DB with Darius Butler, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, DBut, AJ Hawk, and the boys break down Everything DB, then head In The Trenches with AQ Shipley. Joining the progrum is Color Commentator for CBS' #1 booth and Future Hall of Famer, JJ Watt to talk about Lane Johnson’s retirement from football, the Chiefs seemingly being all the way back to their old selves, his coverage on CBS and their historic season thus far, referees receiving suspensions, and how having a dominant offensive line can completely change a defensive scheme.  Then, ESPN Analyst, 2x Super Bowl Champion, and future Hall of Famer Jason Kelce stops by to react to the breaking news of Pro Bowl Center Cam Jurgens being traded to the Baltimore Ravens. Jason also reflects on Lane Johnson’s incredible career and the impact he had not only on the Philadelphia Eagles, but on the game of football as a whole. Plus, he talks about trying some things he’s always wanted to do, including learning and playing rugby and taking on a friend of the progrum Ichi in sumo wrestling.  Later, World Boxing Legend Canelo Alvarez joins the show to talk about his upcoming fight against Christian Mbilli for the WBC Super Middleweight Title on October 31st in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.  Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or watch on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+.  We appreciate the hell out of all of you. We’ll see you tomorrow. Cheers. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: PMS 2.0 1639 - MNF Recap, Bryce Young, Vikings Head Coach Kevin O'Connell, Rece Davis, Darius Butler, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, DBut, AJ Hawk, and the boys recap last night’s dominant victory by the Atlanta Falcons on the road in New Orleans along with other news around the football world.   Joining the progrum is Carolina Panthers Quarterback Bryce Young, who talks about his recent success, Panthers fans and the Carolina community, his evolution over the years in the NFL, the week-to-week game plan, the challenges of working with different playcallers, his arm strength, and Tetairoa McMillan’s breakout performance on Sunday night.  Then, Minnesota Vikings Head Coach Kevin O’Connell swings by to talk about the mindset of his undefeated Vikings squad, Kyler Murray’s play, Brian Flores’ defense, and more!  Later, College GameDay host Rece Davis stops by to share his personal Top 25 teams in college football and preview College GameDay heading to Tuscaloosa. He also breaks down his Rece’s Pieces from the weekend, including Jeremiah Smith being on pace for one of the best seasons of all time, Miami continuing to separate itself from the rest of the country, and Northwestern’s success with Chip Kelly. Rece also reacts to Who Sits Atop Tone’s Above Average Poll. Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or watch on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+. We appreciate the hell out of all of you! item.title: PMS 2.0 1637 - LIVE From Iowa with Ian Rapoport, Nick Saban, Ben McCollum, Kirk Ferentz & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, AJ Hawk, and the boys are LIVE from Iowa City in front of a packed crowd after the Iowa Hawkeyes host College GameDay & Ohio State tomorrow. They react to everything happening around ball, including last night’s win for the Browns against the Steelers, along with this weekend’s slate of college and NFL games.  Junior NFL Insider for ESPN Ian Rapoport joins the progrum to chat about Joey Porter Jr.'s availability this Sunday following the trade to Dallas from Pittsburgh, and the injury statuses of players around the league.  The GOAT and 7X National Champion, Nick Saban, joins the show to talk about Iowa football and their fans, Iowa-Ohio State, the impact of Ohio State receiver Jeremiah Smith, and his life away from coaching. Iowa Men’s basketball Head Coach Ben McCollum stops by to talk about what it means to be the head coach for the Hawkeyes, his relationship with Kirk Ferentz, his team heading into the 2026-2027 season, and what winning at Iowa does for recruiting in an NIL driven world. Iowa Football Head Coach, living legend, Kirk Ferentz joins us to discuss the additions to his Hawkeyes offense that has made a difference this season, why his players have been successful in the NFL, his thought process and the importance of special teams, along with what it means to him to being staple over the last 28 years of Iowa football. And to finish the show Stanford Steve joins the lads to pick the entire NFL slate with Ty and the Iowa faithful picking games for charity!  Make sure to subscribe to https://youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or watch on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+. We appreciate the hell out of all of you! We’ll see you tomorrow. Cheers. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: PMS 2.0 1636 - TNF Preview/Picks, Mark Kaboly, Kirk Herbstreit, Florida Running Back Jadan Baugh, Coach Chuck Pagano, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, AJ Hawk, Coach Chuck Pagano, and the boys break down all things ball including plays that make you go “What The Chuck?”, along with reacting to playoff baseball, NHL games, and more, before previewing tonights TNF game between the Steelers and Browns and make their picks. Joining the progrum is Pittsburgh Steelers Beat Reporter Mark Kaboly to talk about the Cowboys trading for Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr, and Mike Tomlin’s Minecraft world he built through the back half of his time in Pittsburgh. Thursday Night Football color commentator Kirk Herbstreit stops by and learns all about Coach Mike Tomlin’s Minecraft hobby, then breaks down tonight’s TNF matchup between division rivals as the Pittsburgh Steelers take on the Cleveland Browns, and GameDay coming to Iowa City as the Hawkeyes take on the Buckeyes.  Then, Florida Gators star running back Jadan Baugh answers Kirk Herbstreit's question about Buster Faulkner’s offense, discusses Jon Sumrall’s message for Ole Miss and keeping that same mindset for Missouri on Saturday. item.title: PMS 2.0 1635 - Watt Wednesday with JJ Watt, David Ross, Wayne Gretzky, In the Trenches with AQ Shipley, Everything DB with Darius Butler, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, DBut, AJ Hawk, and the boys touch on everything around the sports world, and then they dive into ‘Everyhthing DB’ and go ‘In The Trenches’ with AQ Shipley. Joining the show, the boys have a slew of great guests starting with CBS Analyst and Future Hall of Famer, JJ Watt reflects on his time in Brazil while being on site for the Ravens-Cowboy game, including his experience at the gym in Rio, running into Stephen A. Smith at Christ The Redeemer, breaks down the atmosphere during the “Trio in Rio”, the Chiefs who take on the Raiders this Sunday, and the Houston Texans woes. Then, 2x World Series Champion and Baseball Analyst for ESPN David Ross stops by to react to an incredible night of playoff baseball, and dives into tonight’s games. And, The Great One Wayne Gretzky joins the progrum as the NHL season starts and talks about his time and mindset as a player, the pressure on Connor McDavid, the Boston Bruins rebuilding and their young star James Hagens, and realistic expectations for the Pittsburgh Penguins. item.title: PMS 2.0 1634 - MNF Recap, MLB Playoffs Preview with Mark DeRosa, Rece Davis, NHL Opening Night Preview with Erik Johnson, Darius Butler, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, DBut, AJ Hawk, and the boys get excited for a ton of sports taking place today including the MLB Postseason, NHL kicking of its season, the WNBA playoffs are happening, and as usual they talk about everything happening with ball. Joining the progrum, Manager of Team USA, 16 year MLB veteran, and MLB Analyst Mark Derosa to talk about the MLB Postseason beginning today with 4 wild card games starting with Phillies-Braves, followed by White Sox-Astros, Yankees-Red Sox and finally Cubs-Padres. College Gameday Host Rece Davis stops by to chat about College Gameday heading to Iowa City as the Hawkeyes take on the Ohio State Buckeyes, his Rece’s Pieces, Florida being the real deal, and some sneaky teams in the Big Ten. Then to cover the NHL, Stanley Cup Champion, 17 year NHL veteran, and ESPN Hockey Analyst Erik Johnson comes on to discuss tonight’s NHL slate as they kick off the season with the Florida Panthers taking on the Carolina Hurricanes, Canadiens take on the Maple Leafs, Rangers face the Bruins, and to end the night, the Canucks head to Edmonton in a matchup versus the Oilers.  Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or watch on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+. item.title: PMS 2.0 1633 - OVERREACTION MONDAY, NFL Week 3 Recap, MNF Preview/Picks, Ian Rapoport, Dan Orlovsky, Oregon Head Coach Dan Lanning, Darius Butler, & AJ Hawk
item.description: On today’s show, Pat, DBut, AJ Hawk, and the boys overreact to this weekend’s incredible slate of NFL games, and reveal the top five storylines of Week 3. Joining the progrum to discuss everything NFL is Junior ESPN Insider Ian Rapoport who provides information on JJ McCarthy being traded to the New York Giants and his time frame on seeing the field amidst Jaxson Dart’s injury, Packers Offensive Line woes, and the Bears quarterback situation tonight vs. the Eagles. Then 12 year NFL veteran at QB and ESPN NFL Analyst Dan Orlovsky breaks down Brock Purdy and the 49ers, Drake Maye’s very underwhelming start, his favorite offensive trends around the league, and tonight’s matchup between the Bears-Eagles on Monday Night Football. Lastly, Oregon Head Coach Dan Lanning gives the boys an update on QB Dante Moore who was injured after a brutal hit during the Ducks game vs. USC, talks about his process going into a bye week, Big Ten teams, and their schedule the rest of the way. Make sure to subscribe to youtube.com/thepatmcafeeshow or watch on ESPN (noon–2 p.m. EDT), ESPN’s YouTube channel (noon–3 p.m. EDT), or ESPN+. We appreciate the hell out of all of you.
